attchmntText: Sakuma Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sakuma Exports Limited announced the outcome of its board meeting held on 14th November 2026. The board considered and approved the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The limited review report on these financial results by the statutory auditor was also approved. The company stated that there are no deviations or variations regarding proceeds from public issues, rights issues, preferential issues, or qualified institutions placements. There are no outstanding defaults on loans and debt securities. Related party transactions are detailed in the XBRL submission. The disclosure regarding the impact of audit qualifications is not applicable as this is a second-quarter filing.
